findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria Scope lists only `substrate/prometheus-research/Cargo.toml`, `src/job/checkpoint.rs`, `src/job/spawn.rs`, `src/mcp_server/mod.rs`, and `tests/job_lifecycle.rs` as files this change may create/edit/delete, but the diff modifies `substrate/prometheus-research/Cargo.lock`.
